description: Package vulnerability scan (batch) — Scan up to 30 packages for known vulnerabilities (OSV.dev) in one call. packages = comma-separated name@version entries (PyPI style name==version also accepted). Optional ecosystem = npm (default), PyPI, Go, Maven, crates.io, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist. Returns per-package verdicts, fixed-in versions and advisory ids, plus an overall verdict (CLEAN / REVIEW / UPGRADE NOW) and a fix-first list ordered by severity. Price: $0.03 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: dev_vulns_batch
